usage: explainthisrepo [-h] [--doctor] [--version] [--llm PROVIDER]
                       [--output FILE]
                       [--quick | --simple | --detailed | --stack | --map]
                       [command] [repository]

The fastest way to understand any unfamiliar codebase using real project signals. Not blind AI guessing. Signals first. LLM second.

positional arguments:
  command               Optional command (e.g. explainthisrepo init)
  repository            GitHub repository (owner/repo or URL), GitHub file or directory path, local directory, or local file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --doctor              Run diagnostics
  --version             Show version
  --llm PROVIDER        LLM provider to use (e.g. gemini, openai, ollama, anthropic, openrouter). Overrides config default.
  --output FILE, -o FILE
                        Specify a custom output file path (default: EXPLAIN.md).
                        Supports formats like .md, .txt, or .doc.
                        Nested paths to save output (e.g path/, path/to/file.md, or path/to/directory/)
                        Directories are created automatically if they don't exist
  --quick               Quick, fast overview mode
  --simple              Simplified summary mode
  --detailed            Full detailed breakdown mode
  --stack               Stack detection mode. No LLM calls are made
  --map                 Navigation system map that shows where to start, what matters and what to ignore before touching it

Aliases:

  etr                          short alias for faster typing
  explain-this-repo            readable alias
  explainthisrepo              primary command

Input formats:

  explainthisrepo owner/repo
  explainthisrepo https://github.com/owner/repo
  explainthisrepo github.com/owner/repo
  explainthisrepo git@github.com:owner/repo.git
  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/directory
  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/file.py
  explainthisrepo .
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/directory
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/file.py

Modes:

  explainthisrepo owner/repo --detailed
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --quick
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --simple
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --stack
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --map

Local directories analysis:

  explainthisrepo .
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/directory
  explainthisrepo . --detailed
  explainthisrepo . --quick
  explainthisrepo . --simple
  explainthisrepo . --stack
  explainthisrepo . --map

Files and directories analysis:

  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/directory
  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/directory --quick
  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/directory --simple
  explainthisrepo owner/repo/path/to/directory --detailed
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/file.py
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/file.py --quick
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/file.py --simple
  explainthisrepo ./path/to/file.py --detailed

Providers:

  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm gemini
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm openai
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm ollama
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm anthropic
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm groq
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --llm openrouter

Output:

  explainthisrepo owner/repo --output file.md
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --output path/to/file.md
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --output path/to/directory/file.md
  explainthisrepo owner/repo --output path/to/directory

Setup:

  explainthisrepo init
  explainthisrepo --doctor
  explainthisrepo --doctor --llm <model name>
  explainthisrepo --version

GitHub token:

  Access private repos and higher rate limits
  Run:
   explainthisrepo init
  Or set:
   GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_xxx explainthisrepo owner/repo

Support:

  Report bugs or feedback to caleb@explainthisrepo.com
